classification: fixed exploratory sensitivity design, not parameter optimization
pairing: Same new seed tuple per replicate for response/control and all conditions. Same control interval gives identical trajectory prefixes across windows. Different control intervals consume uniforms at different times: shared seeds are not a common continuous Poisson path.
saturation_definition: Controller rates at actual decisions t > 0 and t < duration, excluding final decision with no subsequent motion; fractions across decisions per trajectory, then equally weighted trajectory means.
